heading: cyGeneral applications
paragraphs: cyAfter you submit your claim, the court will usually schedule a court hearing automatically.
cyThere are some instances where you might not want the court to do this or the court needs to be made aware of something beforehand.
bullets: cythe defendants’ address is not in England or Wales
cyyou want the court to schedule a hearing that the defendants should not be notified about
afterBullets: cyTo stop the court from automatically scheduling a hearing, you must make a general application within 24 hours of submitting this claim.
cyIf you make a general application after this time period, the court will schedule a hearing automatically and your general application might not be considered until after the hearing.
question: cyDo you need to make a general application before the court schedules a hearing?

errors.generalApplicationIntent: cySelect whether you need to make a general application
